name: onex
description: ONEX single-command local LLM delegation. Ships exactly one skill (delegate) — no hooks, no agents. The full ONEX dev skill surface (108+ skills, hooks, agents) is internal tooling and is not part of this consumer-facing package as of OMN-14688.

onex_cli.notes: OMN-16041/OMN-16191: three packages, one environment. `omnibase-core` ships the `onex` console script; the `delegate` SUBCOMMAND is registered by `omnibase-infra` via the `onex.cli` entry-point group; the backing node `node_delegate_skill_orchestrator` is shipped by `omnimarket` and found through the `onex.nodes` entry-point group. Installing omnibase-core alone yields `Error: No such command 'delegate'` (exit 2); installing core+infra without omnimarket yields `Error: Unknown node 'node_delegate_skill_orchestrator'` (exit 1). Node lookup reads installed distributions, not a workspace clone, so no $OMNI_HOME or local omnimarket checkout is required. Python 3.12+ required.
